blocks.text: Sophia Laforteza will resume group activities with KATSEYE in the first week of January 2027, HYBE and Geffen Records announced on Thursday, Oct. 8. In a notice posted on Weverse, the companies said Laforteza has been prioritizing her health and well-being with their full support and resources and that they “look forward to celebrating her return with the fans in the new year.” “We are happy to share that Sophia will resume group activities with KATSEYE beginning the first week of January 2027,” the notice said.
